text: Welcome to your hall. Move the view with ←→ ↑↓ (or drag with the middle button), and change the level with [<] and [>] (or the wheel). Do both: the z field below shows the level.

Look at things with [k], or a click on the map. The look panel's Tile tab lists all that lies on the tile, and the status row names what is under the pointer. Look at a tile, then at one of your dwarves.

Open Designate with [d]: Dig is chosen. Go down a level with [<] into the rock, click one corner of a box, then the opposite corner (or Enter twice). The marked tiles blink while the work waits for a miner.
Stairs lead down. In Designate, [S-j] chooses down stairs: click a floor tile twice. Change the level between the two clicks and the box makes a stair column, down stairs on top and up stairs below.
Hauled goods need a place. Open Zones with [z], choose a stockpile with [S-s], and drag a rectangle over open floor (or Enter at two corners).
Open Build with [b], then [w] for the workshops. Choose one with ↑↓ and Enter, then click a free spot, or Enter at the cursor. Dwarves build it once time runs.
Workshops make what is ordered. Open Orders with [o]: [S-n] adds an order, type part of a recipe's name and press Enter. An order waits for a workshop that can make it.
Food grows on soil. In Zones ([z]), [S-f] chooses a farm plot: drag it over soil or grass. Click the plot to choose its crop for each season.
A dwarf works only at the labors that are on. Open Labors with [l]: ↑↓ choose a dwarf, a click on a cell turns that labor on or off, and [S-a] turns the whole row.
Time stands still while the game is paused. [Space] pauses and resumes, and [+] and [-] change the speed. Run the fortress at 2× or 4×, then pause it again.
Save your fortress: [F5] makes a quick save, and Esc opens the game menu, which has Save. Saves are kept in this browser.
